thread:
Irene Morales: Heads-up: weve flipped on a small MI250X warm/burst pool in Nairobi (NBO) for Dedicated tenants effective immediately. This is targeted at reducing regional tail latency for customers in EMEA+Africa.

Devon K: Sweet. Whats the size and per-tenant limits?

Irene Morales: Initial capacity = 40 MI250X GPUs. Per-tenant burst cap = 8 GPUs. Single reservation max = 6 hours. Were enforcing a cooldown of 2h between burst reservations per tenant.

Samir Patel: Is this available for Private/VPC customers?

Irene Morales: Not for Private/VPC. Private customers will need to procure hardware or opt into a dedicated colocated offering later. This pool is for Hosted Dedicated only.

Maya Chen: Rolling plan and testing?

Irene Morales: Canary with 3 enterprise tenants for 48h starting now. Ops will monitor scheduling latency, eviction rates, and cold-start memory spikes. If green, we open self-serve reservations next Tuesday at 16:00 UTC.

Priya G: Ops question  what alerts should oncall look for?

Irene Morales: Key alerts: scheduler.backlog > 50 for >5m, gpu.provision.failures, unexpected_preemptions. Runbook posted. If free capacity drops below 10% for >15m trigger infra-backfill paging list.

OpsBot: RUNBOOK: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mi250x-nbo-burst (includes escalation matrix and CLI recovery steps)

Irene Morales: CLI example for CS to demo:

```
# reserve 4 MI250X for 3h in burst pool
redwoodctl capacity reserve --pool mi250x-nbo-burst --count 4 --duration 3h --team acme-inc
```

Samir Patel: Any cost/sku differences?

Irene Morales: Pricing = Dedicated on-demand * 1.25 (temporary until pool grows). Billing line item labeled "burst-dedicated-mi250x". Well update pricing page and billing docs later today.

Devon K: Performance notes? Any kernel changes or quantization guidance?

Irene Morales: Were rolling an optimized MI250X kernel build tomorrow to reduce cold memory pressure. Short-term: recommend small batch sizes for the first 5k tokens while KV warms. Customers running very large models should pin lower concurrency.

Maya Chen: Docs/comms owner?

Irene Morales: CS owns customer outreach; eng-docs + product own docs. Draft doc here: https://redwood.internal/docs/mi250x-nbo-burst. Please leave comments by EOD.

Priya G: Quota changes? We need to ensure global quota enforcement still holds.

Irene Morales: We added a transient "burst_quota" bucket that allows temporary override of steady-state caps while enforcing per-tenant burst limits. Watch metrics quota.burst.* for anomalies.

Priya G: I'll schedule 11:00 UTC health checks for the next 3 days to validate scheduler behavior.

Irene Morales: TL;DR: MI250X warm/burst pool live in NBO, 40 GPUs total, per-tenant cap 8, 6h max per reservation, canary live now, self-serve next Tue, temporary 1.25x pricing, runbook + CLI linked. Ping me for access or edge cases. :rocket:

Devon K: Thanks! :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Looping in two customers to test. Thanks team.
